novelty.justification: The novelty route is the proposed mechanism and measurement that “answer-content specificity is a difficulty-gated behavioral axis distinct from confidence wording and abstention” and that vague answers exhibit a recoverable “Knowledge-Masking Gap.” Searches using “LLM semantic specificity vague answers hidden knowledge,” “language model hedging commitment activation steering,” “LLM uncertainty answer specificity,” and “decoding withheld/refused knowledge” identify the closest work as Can Large Language Models Faithfully Express Their Intrinsic Uncertainty in Words? (2024), Linearly Decoding Refused Knowledge in Aligned Language Models (2025), Causal Evidence that Language Models use Confidence to Drive Behavior (2026), and Reported Confidence in LLMs Tracks Commitment More Than Correctness (2026). Moving from those studies of hedging-faithfulness, decodable suppressed knowledge, and steerable answer-versus-abstention commitment to graded, self-generated content underspecification that masks recoverable correct answers is a non-trivial multi-step integration and new operationalization, but a natural extension rather than a wholly new core paradigm.
